request: At DocumentViewSet.notes POST handler entry, can an authenticated user who has all listed global POST permissions and an object view grant on a document create a note when a different user owns the document and the caller has no object change_document grant?

policySources.text: Creating a note requires the POST global note/document permissions and an owner-aware change_document check on the target document; viewing the document alone is insufficient.

acceptance.reason: Public fixed-ref source and task-author bounded requirement.

principals.role: authenticated user with global note POST permissions and only object view access
principals.description: Author facts: ["The caller has documents.add_note, documents.view_document, and documents.change_document global permissions.","The caller has an object view grant but no object change grant on the document."]

resources.description: Author facts: ["The document exists and is owned by another user.","The caller is not its owner."]
